lede: Led by Professor Stefano A. Bini MD, COSI is a research lab in the UCSF Department of Orthopaedic Surgery. We use machine learning, population-scale clinical data, biomechanical simulation, and surgical robotics to change how hip and knee surgery is studied, planned, and performed.
bone_caption: Derived from a machine-learning segmentation of an MRI hip scan.
involve1_desc: Take on research with real clinical impact, publish it, and work alongside talented engineers and clinicians.
involve2_desc: Pilot technology with the surgeons who will use and disseminate it and a lab that will bring it to the next level
